scenario: Two aggregation lines in one series declaration per LSER.13.1 — both `mean` and `stdev` available. After two observations, mean = 22.5 > 15.0 → rule fires. Pin: action_log appears after 3 asserts+pumps.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Temp scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    celsius: Float mutable

series Temp.celsius:
    mean sliding 30_s
    stdev sliding 30_s

rule multi_agg:
    Temp t where t.mean > 15.0
->
    log info "warm"
